notes.title: HARD MODE & NEW GAME+ Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/73f06f84946a909ee3efc20e01cae7f4e0be1f2d.png[/img]

Hello, we are KIWIWALKS!
We are excited to introduce Version 1.301 and its additions of Hard Mode and NG+.

Read further for more details!

[b][h2]<1.301 Update Notes>[/h2][/b]
1. New difficulty levels added - Hard/Very Hard
- The patterns of boss and semi-boss enemies are changed.
- Some player skills are rebalanced for these difficulties only.

[h3]2. New Game Plus Mode (NG+)[/h3]
1) Can be started via "New Story" on the title screen
2) If you have a record of viewing the ending, you can use any save file to start again from Chapter 1.
- The initial tutorial story will be skipped and you will start in the middle of Chapter 1.
3) New content exclusive to NG+ mode
- New monsters
- New equipment

[h3]3. Quality of Life Features[/h3]
1) Auto-skip Dialog
- Added an option to automatically skip dialog once voiced lines end.
2) Crafting Mastery
- Once you craft a healing potion/combat tool 3 times, you will get double the amount of crafting experience in subsequent crafts.

[h3]4. Skill Balancing[/h3]
1) Increased efficiency of HP-consuming skills
- Each time you use a skill that consumes HP, its power is increased by 36%. Combining skills with this effect will increase the power of all of them.
- Applies to: Overload Strike 1, Overload Strike 2, Ultimate Strike, Ecarr Vertel, Ecarr Half
2) Life Staff
- HP recovery amount from skills can now be amplified with Strategic CRIT.
- Excess recovery amount from skills is capped at 65% of max HP.
3) Pet Balancing
- Lucca: The number of cooldown turns required when using Turn Pass has been changed.
Changed from 1 turn on first use and 4 turns subsequently to 3 turns on first use and 3 turns subsequently.
- Aslan: Increased power of secondary skill.
4) Added more defense skills on top of Basic Defense
- Charge Strength (from Physical Training Stage 2)
- Charge Magic (from Mental Training Stage 2)

[h3]5. Hard/Very Hard Mode-Exclusive Balancing [/h3]
1) The duration of certain defense buffs has been adjusted from 2 turns to 1 turn.
2) The maximum power of skills affected by enhancement (eg. Peanut Shark) will be limited to the highest level of Attack Blessings.
3) Added a new defense skill for Warriors. After being attacked a certain number of times, they will instantly enter Defense state, greatly reducing damage.
4) Boss/Semi-Boss Enemies
- Boss battle patterns will be added or changed.
- Some boss stats will increase proportionally to the player's stats

[h3]6. Various bug and localization fixes[/h3]

---

For any questions about the game or submitting bug reports, please use our official Discord channel.
Thank you!

Official Discord: [url=https://discord.com/invite/witchspring]https://discord.com/invite/witchspring[/url]

notes.title: [Dev Notes] HARD MODE & NG+ Update Trailer, ETC
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/5daa5feea1ef77383a47f91658e97cb467b5d465.png[/img]

Hello, We are KIWIWALKS!
We have some exciting news to share with everyone!

In addition to the highly anticipated Hard Mode, we are currently working hard to introduce the New Game+(NG+) feature. We are preparing to release these features simultaneously in February, so please bear with us a little longer :)

[previewyoutube=Vfgnd_TRDH0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]1. Hard Mode Update[/h3]
In the upcoming update, two new difficulty levels will be added:
- Hard/Very Hard difficulty levels
- Balancing adjustments to some player skills at difficulty levels beyond Hard.
- Some monster skills/patterns will be added or modified.

[h3]2. New Game Plus (NG+) Update[/h3]
In the next update, the NG+ feature will be added, allowing players who have completed the game to inherit their save file and start from chapter 1.
- Skip the early tutorial and start the game from the middle of chapter 1.
- A few monsters will only appear in NG+ mode.
- New equipments will only appear in NG+ mode.

[h3]3. New Features Update [/h3]
In the next update, some features will be implemented.
- Story Enjoyment Feature: An option to automatically advance dialogue after voice playback ends.
- Crafting Mastery: Crafting recovery potions/combat tools three times or more will yield double the items in subsequent crafting.

[h3]4. Publisher Change[/h3]
As some of you may have noticed, we have recently ended our collaboration with the publisher and have decided to independently service the game. 
Due to this change, there will be adjustments to the overall development schedule as several complex tasks need to be addressed.

[h3]5. Post-Ending Content Schedule Change[/h3]
Due to the termination of the publishing contract, all schedules involving external collaboration, such as voice recording, will be reassessed. Details will be announced once finalized.

[h3]6. Console Porting[/h3]
- In addition to the previously announced Nintendo Switch port, we are preparing to port the game to other console platforms. 
- A physical package (limited edition + artbook!) is also in the works.

[h3]7. MOFUN Collaboration Merch Reservation Period Extension[/h3]
- Due to popular demand, the reservation period for collaboration products has been extended until February 12th! 
- For detailed purchase information, please refer to the previous announcements.
🔗[url=https://en.mostore.co.kr/category/witch-spring/95/]https://en.mostore.co.kr/category/witch-spring/95/[/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1958220/view/3889485811035730855

[h3]8. Season FanArt Contest Winners Announcement[/h3]
- A sincere thank you to everyone who participated in the 2023 Season Fan Art Contest!
- We will announce the winners of the fan art contest and the giveaway event on January 31st, so stay tuned for the results! 

We'll continue to work hard to bring you more exciting news in the new year :) 
Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Patch Note 1.193
[Game Update Plan] About working-on content, DLC, and console port
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Kiwiwalks!

It has been over two weeks since the release of [i]WitchSpring R[/i]! Due to the game's extensive content compared to our previous products, we were excited yet anxious before it went live. It wasn't until we received stable reviews and encouragement from everyone after the first week that we breathed a sigh of relief and sincerely thanked everyone for their support of Kiwiwalks and [i]WitchSpring R[/i].

During the first week online, we fixed some bugs and iterated the version quite frequently. After a brief slowdown, we have made plans for future updates and hope to share them with you as soon as possible.

[b][u]Regarding game DLC and future updates [/u][/b]

[b]About Costumes[/b]
We have prepared various styles of clothing for Pieberry since the beginning. As mentioned earlier, there are also some new costumes that are currently in QA phase and are expected to go on sale as paid DLC within the next 1-2 months. You can have a peak at one of the costumes from the following pictures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/49ccb65a72141f1adea72aae043a7faed0dc96a3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/e9a64c3971d8310bbac02ec032e93fb78e89dbf6.png[/img]

The new paid DLC costumes will consist of two sets of clothing for both younger and grown-up Pieberry, so you can see two different clothes based on the same design concept. 

We hope you will enjoy the new look and charm of Pieberry with these additional costumes!

[b]About NG+ mode[/b]
We noticed that many players are asking about this feature. However, we've never worked on implementing an NG+ system before, so the workload is hard to estimate. We also noticed that most players are asking for this feature mainly to complete all achievements and collections after the main story, so we are considering a more suitable way to satisfy these demands. 
Oh, and just a note, you can also go back to your older "saves" to complete achievements.
If there are other reasons or demands for requiring this feature, please feel free to email us or leave a message on the official Discord, thank you!

[b]About new content after "the end"[/b]
Like other WitchSpring games, WitchSpring R was initially designed to have "an ending".However, thanks to everyone's love and support, we're preparing a piece of free additional story content; but the preparation time will be relatively long (as before). We're aiming for an update at 2024 Q1 for now. More details will be shared in the future dev logs.

[b][u]Regarding console versions[/u][/b]

Besides the PC version, we also plan to create a console version of WitchSpring R. We're currently testing and preparing for the port, and if everything goes smoothly, we expect to complete the work in 2024 H1. There's also a plan to make a physical deluxe version, similar to WitchSpring 3: Refine. 
Stay tuned for more information！

Finally, if you encounter any issues in the game, please don't hesitate to reach out to us through our official Discord or email. We are also preparing for more upcoming community events, so stay tuned!

Thank you!

notes.title: [Game Release Notes] It's finally the release date!
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Kiwiwalks! 

Today is finally THE day! 
It has been nearly a month since our last note, we have made improvements, added a bit more content, and fine-tuned various aspects of the game.

As we have already covered most gameplay systems in previous dev notes, we won't dive into the specifics again.

Apart from the growth/progression system that most[i] WitchSpring[/i] fans are already familiar with, [b][i]WitchSpring R[/i][/b] features a more strategic (and sometimes tactical) battle system. We hope this will reduce the monotony of repetitive battles, allowing players to enjoy winning battles through various mixes and matches. And for those who may find it challenging, there is a "simple" difficulty level available in the settings menu, which should make everything much easier. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/2fa6e5a1c4da754a0f368f3a8d1e9ee5a8636aef.png[/img]

In addition, we would like to update the inaccurate description in the last notes. After observing the game process of some experienced players, we found that the completion time of the main story should be around 22-25 hours; and there are 20 types of pets/monsters that can be capture, while you will also meet companions who can go on adventures together, and assist in battles.

Regarding the story, we have introduced some new charming characters in [i]WitchSpring R[/i]. Their presence has greatly improved the richness of the game story and the overall worldview. Furthermore, these characters have unique side-quests that you can discover, and completing them will unlock hidden story scenes at the end of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/e2f5442a8ffbe4cb5ffbdcca9847ef6edda2b685.png[/img]

In response to player feedback, we have made several adjustments to the game's audio, and display, and tested the device performance, and compatibility. Players have mentioned issues with the SFX and music volume ratio, which can now be adjusted separately. The game is also compatible with older operating systems such as WIN 7 and 8, but we still strongly recommend playing the game with the minimum requirements stated on the store page. If you experience frame drops or freezes, you can try adjusting the game's image quality,  which could help to improve performance. If you encounter any compatibility issues, please email our customer service team. They will respond asap to help resolve the issue.

[i]WitchSpring R[/i] is Kiwiwalks' first PC and console game. We chose Pieberry as the protagonist because her story serves as the basis for the entire [i]WitchSpring[/i] story. Pieberry is a kind and adorable little witch who never gives up, we hope you will enjoy embarking on this adventure with her.

Now the game can run perfectly on Steamdeck, we hope it could be a temporary "substitute" for players who like to play games on handheld devices.   

After the game's release, we plan to take a short break and then prepare the game's soundtrack and additional costumes as paid DLC. Please look forward to the DLC release!

Finally, if you enjoy playing the game, we would sincerely appreciate it if you could leave a positive review in the store. This will greatly assist us. We also welcome you to join our Discord server or follow our official Twitter account to stay up-to-date with community events. If you encounter any issues while playing the game, please feel free to contact our customer service email (wsr@pixmain.com) at any time.

Thank you and have fun!

notes.title: 【Dev Log】 Recent progress & Release Info update
notes.notes:
Hi guys! This is Suyoung, the producer of WitchSpring R. It's been a while since our last Dev Log, but we've made good progress on a playable build of WitchSpring R since then. 

In the meantime, I will try my best to keep WitchSpring fans updated with what we're working on now, so the frequency of future Dev Logs will increase to once per month!

We are currently still focusing on game production and have recently finished:
1. The main setting of the game, world view, main character design (check the details here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1958220/view/3458229997600763926)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/e53a2f7d875b431af4bcbc8a044b96fe48fd8781.png[/img]
2. Map and monster design
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/a943633496da8b974f35c330ad9becf8b561647a.png[/img]
3. The main gameplay & mini-game system
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/c412d139b9f0fc713d740a78a0d06fe71d17bc00.png[/img]


For the rest of 2022, we will be working on:
1. Improving 2D illustration and adding 3D art
2. Sound related work
3. Tweaking game balance and other game content work
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/db2da19a3d92d43ae8e7ea36bd39fd51a3ce304a.png[/img]

Since we want to make WitchSpring R as perfect as we can, we've gone deep into detail on each part of the development process, causing us to re-evaluate our release timeline. 

Our new timeline targets a 2023 release. By December 2022, we will finish the basic game dev. In the following months, we will focus on the voiceover, quality assurance, soundtrack, and other polish. 

If I had developed and published the game by myself, I would have completed development and released the game in a similar timeframe as I have before . However, now I'm hoping to show WitchSpring R to everyone in a more complete form with the help of a publisher, so we'll need a little more time for the official release.

With the development process coming to an end, this decision was also very difficult for us. This is the first time KIWIWALKS has created a game for PC / console from scratch. It was not just simple porting work, but a decision to create a completely new WitchSpring R. We apologize to everyone for the change in the scheduled release time.

A playable demo will be released in Spring 2023, and we are so excited for you to experience the demo of WitchSpring R soon! We can not wait to share it with more people. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/3ae99015c8200e84fbbe1ead0cf90fc8807a8a28.png[/img]

Oh, and I heard from the publishing team that today is Thanksgiving day. We hope this Dev Log finds you all well, and we want to express our deep appreciation to all the players who support us! Thank you for your warm words and future support. See you again soon!
